question_text: Construct 3NF tables with primary and foreign keys for a service business. Each CustomerID determines CustomerName. Each EngineerID determines EngineerName and Specialty. Each ServiceID determines ServiceName and a fixed Price. A visit has a unique VisitID and one customer, engineer, service and VisitTime. There are no other dependencies.
adaptation_rationale: Make dependencies and treatment price explicit so normalization has a determinate solution. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Customer(CustomerID PK, CustomerName); Engineer(EngineerID PK, EngineerName, Specialty); Service(ServiceID PK, ServiceName, Price); Visit(VisitID PK, CustomerID FK, EngineerID FK, ServiceID FK, VisitTime), with the foreign keys referencing the corresponding tables.

marking_points.criterion: Correct Service relation and key, including fixed price.
Correct Visit relation with its key and visit-specific time.
Correct three foreign-key relationships and no copied dependent names/prices.
